🎯 Savings Goals
📌
Please read — how your goal savings work

Savings is a constant bucket. Every time you add income, its Savings share goes into it and is shared equally among your goals automatically — you never need to type an amount.

Want to reach a goal faster? Tap Add Manual on that goal. The amount must be covered by your Bank & Wallet balance. If the balances don’t match, you’ll be warned and it can’t be saved until you top up your accounts or enter a smaller amount.

Add a Goal Cancel edit

Manual “Current Saved” needs matching funds

Anything you type here must be covered by your Bank & Wallet balance, otherwise it can’t be saved. Leave it at 0 to let Savings fund this goal automatically.

Before you add money

Savings already feeds your goals automatically. Add money manually only to speed up this goal — and it must be covered by your Bank & Wallet balance. If it isn’t, you’ll see a warning and can’t save.

Add Bank / Wallet
Balance can't be changed here — leave it as is, or set it to 0 to reset. Use Top Up or Transfer to add or move money.
Every top-up here splits using the same Savings / Expenses buckets set up in Income Allocation — the Expenses bucket's % is what becomes Spendable in this account. There's one shared bucket group for every wallet, not a per-account setting.

Profile Picture
Avatar

Currency
Display Currency

Data Management
Sync to Cloud
Upload your debts and transactions to the cloud so they're backed up and available on your other signed-in devices. Never synced
Export Data
Download your debts and transactions as a JSON backup file.
Import Data
Load a .json file from DebtLedgerPro's Export Data button. This will overwrite current data.
Clear Data
Clear All Transactions
Remove all transaction records. Debt accounts will remain intact.
Clear All Debts
Remove all debt accounts and their linked transactions.
Reset Everything
Permanently delete ALL locally stored data. This cannot be undone.
PIN Security
Enable PIN Lock
Require a PIN when opening this dashboard.
Change PIN
Set a new PIN to replace the current one.
Remove PIN
Disable PIN protection and remove the stored PIN.
